skill.note: Byte-identical to Matt Pocock skills/engineering/pr at d81f3a183412e71a5b1e84ca21bc1a35eea03a60; the catalog test's normalized pin hash matches.

method: Claude Code subagent (general-purpose, Opus 5.5, same host as the Worker) spawned with no conversation history. Its prompt named only the skill path to load and follow, the scenario-input directory, a scratch output path outside the repository and a ban on other writes and on git/gh. It used 5 tool calls and replied 'written'. The produced file was copied byte-for-byte to scenario-output.md.
knownChange: Commit 6dbec705 'Install the pinned pr skill source with lineage': four new files under workbench/skills/pr/ plus a 15-line hash-pin block in tools/test-skill-catalog.mjs. Expected door: two-way. Expected blast radius: branch-local now; every room's Skills lane only after pr is declared in the Core skill bundle and released.

inputs.glossary: scenario-input/GLOSSARY.md is a scenario fixture condensed from LEXICON.md (Room, Skills lane, Core skill bundle, Spec, Task). The room's canonical GLOSSARY.md is undelivered; S-004O owns it.
evidenceRuns: evidence/before.txt: node tools/test-skill-catalog.mjs on the exported 6dbec705 tree with workbench/skills/pr moved aside -> 'must carry the pinned upstream source', exit 1 (reproduces TK-007U's recorded red)

evidence/after.txt: same command on the tree as committed -> passes the pin, fails later at 'live discovery source must contain exactly the locked 28 skills' with extra 'pr', exit 1 (TK-007V's declaration work)
evidence/isolated.txt: the pin assertion block alone, verbatim in a standalone script -> exit 1 without pr, exit 0 with pr
evidence/suite-summary-at-56eb7a9b.txt: TK-007U's full suite on clean candidate 56eb7a9b -> pass=46 fail=7

acceptance.criterion: Brief visual summary present and useful
acceptance.observed: Summary opens with one sentence, then a file-layout diff of the Skills lane with one-line responsibilities per file, then a five-line pseudocode of the new assertion, then one sentence on what the change does not touch. Both visuals sit beside the text they support; no preamble.
acceptance.note: Two visuals rather than one; both carry distinct points (what lands where, what the test checks), within the source's 'one, sometimes several' guidance.

acceptance.observed: Before/after quote the exact assertion messages and exit codes from evidence/isolated.txt. It separately reports that the full catalog test still fails, with the exact message, and the suite result pass=46 fail=7 with the seven failing check names, all matching the evidence files. No screenshot or unrun check is claimed.
acceptance.note: It chose the isolated assertion as the before/after and presented the still-red full test as expected red, which is the honest reading of the input.

acceptance.observed: Door: two-way, because the commit adds files and one test block and a revert removes it. Blast radius: branch-local, because it targets the assembly branch and cuts no release so no Room receives pr; it names the real cost that the branch suite stays red (7 checks) until the follow-up Task.
acceptance.assessment: Accurate for this commit in isolation. It does not mention that once pr is declared and released, every room's Skills lane carries it; the input placed that in a follow-up Task and release, so omitting it is defensible. Imprecision: Merge Danger says the commit 'adds five files and one test block' and the Summary says 'adds files only'; the commit adds four files and edits one existing test file.
acceptance.inputLimit: scenario-input/CHANGE.md stated the door and blast-radius facts outright ('The commit only adds files and one test block; it deletes and rewrites nothing', no manifest or Core-list edit, no release cut) beside a five-file diff stat. The verdict therefore shows faithful restatement of supplied merge-danger facts, not independent derivation from the diff, and that framing partly seeded the five-files miscount. Added after the S-002U assembled review at 24d47f06; the recorded input and body are unchanged and the scenario was not rerun.

acceptance.observed: Uses Skills lane, Core skill bundle, Room, Task and Spec in the fixture's senses; introduces no competing vocabulary.
acceptance.limit: The glossary was a fixture; the room's own GLOSSARY.md does not exist yet.

acceptance.criterion: No Git or PR side effect
acceptance.observed: scenario-environment-diff.md: HEAD, porcelain status including ignored files, this lane's refs, s002u branch list, worktree count and gh pr list (by head branch and by head:claude/s002u search) are identical before and after; diff exit 0. No PR exists for any s002u branch.

alsoObserved: The body carries no Workbench merge-safety and completion answers, consistent with draft finding F:pr:01; the caller must add them.
limits: Single run; no repeat-run variance or comparative quality claim
Merge-danger facts (door, blast radius, add-only shape) were supplied in the input, so independent derivation of Merge Danger from the diff is unobserved
Glossary was a scenario fixture; the canonical GLOSSARY.md is undelivered (S-004O)
Fresh context means no conversation history; the subagent ran in the same host (Claude Code, macOS) and model (Opus 5.5) as the Worker and may have loaded the host's project instructions and memory
Direct skill-path invocation, not ordinary-prompt discovery through the .agents/skills or .claude/skills adapters; pr is not yet declared in the Core skill bundle on this base
The subagent's raw tool transcript is not preserved; only its output file and reply are
